description: Run CodeLedger Agent Quality checks for bounded scope, prompt budget, roadmap slice coverage, and quality wins. Uses the same canonical builders and artifacts as codeledger agent-audit.

mode.description: Which agent-quality report to return. Defaults to all.

persist.description: Persist latest agent-quality runtime artifacts. Defaults to true.

repoRoot.description: Repo root path. Defaults to CODELEDGER_REPO_ROOT or process.cwd().

session.description: Optional session id for artifact attribution.

targetTokens.description: Prompt token target for budget checks.

task.description: Task description used for transaction freshness and read-path context.

name: codeledger_agent_quality
